race.description: Community Bank Fleurieu - Bendigo Bank Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: DARCI LANE (2) has made a bright start to his career and is still improving. Suspect he will relish the mile, though he will need a smart steer from a tricky gate. ROBERT THE PUSS (3) was doing his best work late last start to grab second over a similar trip at Mt Gambier. If they can better utilise the low draw this time he's a big chance. GOODLOOKIN' GURU (6) was too good for a maiden field last start over 1400m at Murray Bridge, scoring by a head. Re-unites with Hammond who was on board last start. No reason she can't go on with it now. YOROKOBI (5) has switched yards since scoring dominantly at Mackay over 1800m on July 17. Expect this to be a bit tougher but he warrants respect.
